With the unchanged product (v,t)(w,s)=(v+w,t+s-omega(v,w)/2), bilinearity gives omega(0,0)=0, so j(t)j(s)=j(t+s), and projection of a product is v+w. j is injective, justifying the hook; every v=pr_V(v,0), justifying the two-headed arrow.

ker(j)={0} is the image of the left trivial group; ker(pr_V)={(0,t):t in R}=j(R); the image of pr_V is V, the kernel of V->1. The composite pr_V j is zero. Local lemma lem-heisenberg-group-lagrangian-splitting-and-dual-orbit step 2.1 explicitly proves kernel/surjectivity and, using nondegeneracy, that j(R) is the entire center. No additional square or commutativity relation is asserted by this linear row.
